description: SCRFD 10GF with keypoints. Fast and accurate at small faces, which is the case that matters -- a group photo where every face is 2% of the frame is the normal case in a family library, not the hard one.

notes: Letterbox rather than stretch: SCRFD's anchors assume square-ish geometry, and stretching a 16:9 frame to 640x640 distorts faces enough to cost recall on small ones. The detection scale factor must be inverted when mapping boxes back to normalised image coordinates. Coordinates written to FaceRecord are normalised against the ORIENTED image, so EXIF rotation is applied before detection, not after. PREPROCESSING CORRECTION: scale was 1/128 alongside mean=127.5/std=128, which applied the division twice and collapsed the whole 0-255 range into a 0.016-wide sliver -- detection and embeddings would have been silently wrong rather than failing. The reference is cv2.dnn.blobFromImage(img, 1/128, size, (127.5,)*3) = (pixel - mean) * scalefactor, which under this config's (pixel * scale - mean) / std form is scale=1.0, mean=127.5, std=128. Caught by Codex in review.
